paths.title: Proof-first shopping launch
paths.label: Recommended next gate
paths.description: Resolve each product's intended ASIN and official listing URL, generate the Special Link inside Associates Central, test one per product, and verify destination plus report attribution before showing purchase buttons.
paths.tradeoff: Slower to activate, but it avoids guessing product intent or implying tracking has been verified.
paths.status: Proposed; not yet authorized or completed

paths.title: Publish the buyer-guide cluster while products remain gated
paths.label: Safe content path
paths.description: Keep the four neutral decision guides live, publish no unsupported product ranking, and add product-specific comparisons only after their source records are complete.
paths.tradeoff: Creates useful editorial pages now; it does not immediately send buyers through affiliate links.
paths.status: Guides prepared; further guides should follow real query evidence

paths.title: Host analytics before optimizing content
paths.label: Measurement path
paths.description: Confirm the event contract first; then consider the included Node aggregate-count endpoint on a separately reviewed host with a same-origin route. Test only the accepted schema and compare site counts with authorized Associates reports.
paths.tradeoff: Requires a separate backend because GitHub Pages is static; both Pages and the default preview remain disabled until the specification and hosting are approved.
paths.status: Event specification and hosting are open; endpoint disabled by default

paths.title: Human-gated product research automation
paths.label: Automation path
paths.description: Connect only an authorized Amazon API/report source, attach provenance and freshness to every field, draft content with citations, and require an editor to approve each disclosure, link, and product claim before publication.
paths.tradeoff: Less autonomous than the original ambition; it prevents absent data from turning into invented scores, prices, or claims.
paths.status: Workflow scaffold only; no API account or model connection supplied

paths.title: Add reader capture only after a working privacy path exists
paths.label: Defer collection
paths.description: Choose a service or endpoint, publish a privacy notice and retention policy, test a working unsubscribe mechanism, and only then add a clearly optional signup form.
paths.tradeoff: No email list starts at launch; readers are not asked to submit an address to a nonfunctional static form.
paths.status: Blocked on service, privacy, and unsubscribe decisions

localChoiceNotice: Selecting a path on the Suggestions page saves a preference in this browser only. It does not publish content, change product links, deploy the site, or contact an external service.
